Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)]]: the cartoon characters Beavis (left) and Butt-Head choosing their ideal woman from an on-screen "MENU: CHICKS" in the 1993 music video for "I Got You Babe" by Cher with Beavis and Butt-Head. Butt-Head presses the box marked "TATTOOS ON BUTT" as he says "We need a chick that's got tattoos on her butt"; the chick they get is Cher. The song is from the album ''The Beavis and Butt-Head Experience'' (Geffen Records, November 1993), not a TV episode.

Source: a single frame (at about 11 seconds) from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jyncsw3yq-k Cher, Beavis And Butt-Head - I Got You Babe], CherVEVO, Cher's official YouTube channel. Black side bars removed and reduced to 640 by 488 pixels. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260202111325/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jyncsw3yq-k Internet Archive], 2 February 2026. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 8546f4b69854ac2e43d38e9cdb49b3b4cead8637996b8d5a9d980b4b91d0da6e.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one frame (640 by 488 pixels) from a 1993 music video, © MTV Networks and Geffen Records, shown to identify the Beavis and Butt-Head joke about Cher's tattooed backside that the card's lore echoes. It is used only for commentary beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It is a single low-resolution frame, so it cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
